text:
GENERATE BURST MOOD-far — Run C-9 P5 background MOOD TEST (Matt: "too few fires, and the background land is too flat. It should be darker due to the horizon's sunset effect and it should have a purple smoky haze ... it all seems too plain"). task_id "MOOD-far".

Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1, a window of a far-landscape parallax layer (a valley seen from high above and far away, with a river; flat pure #00ff00 above the horizon = sky, keep it). Repaint the LAND to fix four things, keeping the painted manuscript hand of the REGISTER CARD above:
1. RELIEF: the land is too flat. Give it real depth: steep ridges and spurs, a few rocky crags, deep valleys and gorges between them, layered ranges receding toward the horizon, each farther range paler and more violet.
2. SUNSET LIGHT: the sun is setting at the LEFT, low. West-facing slopes catch warm gold and orange rim light; everything else falls into deep, rich violet and blue-purple shadow. Overall DARKER than now, with strong contrast between lit ridges and shadowed valleys; the river reflects the orange sky.
3. FIRE: MANY separate fires across the land (eight to twelve), every one a different size and shape — small burning villages, burning woods on slopes, a burning farm — each with its own column of dark smoke drifting to the right; NO two alike.
4. PURPLE SMOKY HAZE: a purple-violet smoke haze hangs over the valleys and thickens with distance, veiling the far ranges; smoke from the fires feeds it.
Rich, deep mineral colour (violet, indigo, rose, ochre-gold, deep green), not pastel. NOTHING repeats. Keep the flat pure #00ff00 sky area above the horizon exactly as it is.

Two image_gen EDIT calls: variants a and b. ONE retry per variant only if the land is still flat and pale, there are fewer than eight fires, repetition appears, or the #00ff00 sky area was painted over — name the reason. Copy outputs to out/MOOD-far_a.png and out/MOOD-far_b.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "MOOD-far"; images = the files with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — THE IMAGE TO EDIT (far land window; keep the #00ff00 sky area)
IMAGE 2 — the sunset sky this land sits under (light direction and colour only)
